road_sampling: Original geometry vertices plus points at <=15m on EPSG:3857 grid; nearest raster cell; minimum DSM height per directed edge.
limitations: DSM includes buildings and vegetation; it is not bare-earth or surveyed road-deck elevation.
Uniform water-surface scenario does not model river hydraulics, connectivity, drainage, barriers, bridges, rainfall or tides.
No elevation precision or flood-depth accuracy is implied by the display contour interval.
